info.name: PH Healthcare API
info.description:
PH Healthcare - Smart Healthcare System backend.

For a deployed server, set the `baseUrl` collection variable to that URL. Defaults to `http://localhost:5000`.

## How to use

1. Run **Auth / Login (Super Admin)**, **Login (Tester Admin)** and **Login (Tester Doctor)** first - each saves its own token (`superAdminToken`, `adminToken`, `doctorToken`) into a collection variable, so every later request is already authenticated for the right role. All three accounts are seeded automatically on every server boot.
2. For a patient-role token: run **Auth / Register (Patient)**, paste the emailed OTP into the `otp` variable, then **Verify email (Patient)** - saves `patientToken`.
3. Run **Doctor / Get all doctors (Admin)** to capture `doctorId`, then **Approve doctor (Admin)** - the seeded doctor starts as `PENDING` and the public doctor endpoints only show `APPROVED` ones.
4. Run **Doctor / Update my profile (Doctor)** to set a `consultationFee` - booking an appointment fails without one.
5. **Schedule / Create schedule (Doctor)** currently always fails - see the known-bug note on that request. Fixing it unblocks Publish schedule, Book appointment, Pay appointment, Update appointment status and Create prescription in sequence.

## Seeded accounts

| Role | Email | Source |
|---|---|---|
| SUPER_ADMIN | superadmin@gmail.com | `SUPER_ADMIN_*` env vars, `seedSuperAdmin()` |
| ADMIN | testeradmin@gmail.com | `TESTER_ADMIN_*` env vars, `seedTesterAdmin()` |
| DOCTOR | testerdoctor@gmail.com | `TESTER_DOCTOR_*` env vars, `seedTesterDoctor()`; starts `verificationStatus: PENDING` |

Passwords are the collection's `superAdminPassword` / `adminPassword` / `doctorPassword` variables, taken from this project's own `.env`.

## Response shape

Success: `{ success, statusCode, message, data, meta? }`
Error: `{ success, statusCode, message, error }` (thrown via `AppError`) or a raw Prisma/unhandled error shape for a couple of endpoints that don't validate input yet (see individual request descriptions).

## Auth

`auth()` middleware accepts either the `accessToken` httpOnly cookie (set automatically by Login/Verify-email/Refresh, and picked up by Postman's cookie jar) or an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. This collection uses the header on every protected request so it works even without cookies enabled.

request.description: No auth. Basic liveness check with API name and version.

Does NOT create the account yet - mails a 6 digit OTP and parks the signup in Redis for a short window. Run **Verify email (Patient)** next with that OTP to finish creating the account.

A fresh `patientEmail` is generated once per collection run so re-runs don't collide with an already-verified account.

request.description: **Manual step**: open the inbox for `patientEmail` (see Register request), copy the 6 digit OTP into the `otp` collection variable, then run this. Saves `patientToken` automatically on success.
Seeded automatically every server boot (`seedSuperAdmin`) from the `SUPER_ADMIN_*` env vars. Saves `superAdminToken`.
Seeded automatically every server boot (`seedTesterAdmin`). Role: ADMIN. Saves `adminToken`.

Seeded automatically every server boot (`seedTesterDoctor`) with a Doctor profile whose `verificationStatus` starts as `PENDING`. Run **Get all doctors (Admin)** then **Approve doctor (Admin)** before relying on doctor-only actions that require approval. Saves `doctorToken`.
Works with any role's token - swap the Bearer token as needed.

No body. Reads the `refreshToken` httpOnly cookie that a prior Login/Verify-email response set. Works automatically in Postman's desktop app if cookies are enabled for this domain (they are by default) - run any Login request first in this session.

request.description: Cannot be scripted here - `idToken` must come from a real Google OAuth sign-in. Paste one into the `googleIdToken` variable to try it manually.
Uses the dynamic `patientEmail` (not a seeded account) so this demo never locks you out of the seeded admin/doctor logins used elsewhere in this collection.
**Manual step**: paste the OTP from Forgot password into the `otp` variable first.
Any authenticated role. Select an image file for the `profileImage` field in Postman before sending - a file can't be embedded in the collection JSON itself.

Public. Multipart form: `data` is a JSON **string** matching `ApplyAsDoctorValidationZodSchema` (already filled in). `resume` (single) and `additionalFiles` (up to 10) are optional file attachments - select real files in Postman or leave empty.

Creates the User+Doctor rows immediately and emails an OTP; the account cannot log in until **Verify doctor email** completes, and stays `verificationStatus: PENDING` until an admin runs **Approve doctor**.

Admin/Super admin only. Includes every non-deleted doctor regardless of verification status. Saves the first result's id into `doctorId` for the requests below.

Public. Approved, non-deleted doctors with a PUBLISHED schedule later today that still has open slots. Empty until a doctor has an approved profile and a published schedule for today.

Public. 404s unless the doctor is approved and not deleted. Run **Approve doctor (Admin)** first.

Doctor only. Start/end are computed fresh each run (15-75 minutes from now, today) via the pre-request script, matching the same-day/not-yet-started rule `bookAppointment` enforces.

**Known bug (verified live on this codebase, 2026-09-19):** `schedule.service.ts`'s `createSchedule` checks `if (existingSchedulesOnThisDate)` on the *array* returned by `findMany`, which is always truthy - even when empty - so every call currently fails with `409 Schedule already exists for this date`, regardless of whether one actually exists. The fix is checking `.length > 0` instead. Until that's patched, this request (and everything downstream that needs a real `scheduleId`: publish/update/delete, book-appointment) cannot succeed end-to-end.
Public. `doctorId` is required - 404s without it.
